message: The HEAD commit is about adding a fuzzer and fixing some reserve() issues. The vulnerability description says "utf-8 encoding failures in malformed .aff files are not properly handled." Let me look at the fuzzer and the affixmgr.cxx code that handles encoding parsing. Let me look at the affdicfuzzer.cxx and the parse_string / encoding handling code.
